scientific_limitations: Named absorbing zero and ternary relational multiplication are essential to the precise statement; no assertion is made for functional multiplication or a language without the zero constant.
The size-26 optimality is only within the family of aperiodic Brandt semigroups, not among arbitrary relational models.
The complete 1980 article was examined, but several other plausible historical papers were accessible only at abstract level; hidden equivalent coverage remains possible.
Finite enumeration corroborates, but does not establish, the infinite theorem. Independent scientific validation remains unperformed.
title: Five three-round theories of finite matrix-unit semigroups
